definitions.directive_command: Direct instruction that the robot should perform an action.
definitions.indirect_request: Non-imperative utterance that implies a robot action under the supplied context.
definitions.information_question: Request for information without committing the robot to an action.
definitions.permission_request: Request asking whether an action is allowed before or instead of performing it.
definitions.prohibition: Utterance forbidding an action or requiring that an action not occur.
definitions.conditional_directive: Directive whose action applies only if stated conditions hold.
definitions.multi_intent: Utterance combining two or more communicative goals that must be annotated jointly.
definitions.other_non_actionable: Utterance outside actionable robot-command scope for this benchmark.
